master.definition_en: A benign condition affecting the dorsum of the tongue. It is characterized by defective desquamation resulting in elongation of the filiform papillae. The dorsum of the tongue has a furry appearance and is usually stained black.

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 单基因遗传缺陷与缺失蛋白的源头修复
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: AI 指导低脱靶编辑器设计、肝脏/心肌/神经组织特异启动子预测、蛋白功能残基致病性建模。

master.name_en: spinocerebellar ataxia, autosomal recessive, with axonal neuropathy 1
master.definition_en: Spinocerebellar ataxia with axonal neuropathy type 1 is a rare, genetic neurological disorder characterized by a late childhood onset of slowly progressive cerebellar ataxia. Initial manifestations include weakness and atrophy of distal limb muscles, areflexia and loss of pain, vibration and touch sensations in upper and lower extremities. Gaze nystagmus, cerebellar dysarthria, peripheral neuropathy, stepagge gait and pes cavus develop as disease progresses. Cerebellar atrophy (especially of the vermis) is present in all affected individuals. Additional reported manifestations include seizures, mild brain atrophy, mild hypercholesterolemia and borderline hypoalbuminemia.

master.name_zh: 自身免疫性溶血性贫血
master.definition_en: Autoimmune hemolytic anemia (AIHA) is an autoimmune disorder in which various types of auto-antibodies are directed against red blood cells causing their survival to be shortened and resulting in hemolytic anemia.

mechanisms: Tumor necrosis factor receptor superfamily member 13C binding agent
Low affinity immunoglobulin gamma Fc region receptor II-b inhibitor

curated.name_zh: 自身免疫性溶血性贫血
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 1) 患者免疫系统产生针对自身红细胞的“叛变抗体”（约65%为37℃活跃的温抗体型wAIHA，约15%为遇冷激活补体的冷凝集素病CAD），将正常红细胞成批破坏溶解; 2) 急性溶血危象时，血红蛋白可在数小时至数天内暴跌至30–40 g/L以下，患者面色惨白、浓茶/酱油色尿、黄疸、心率飙升，随时因重度贫血性心力衰竭、休克或并发致命性肺栓塞死亡。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 温抗体型AIHA一线口服糖皮质激素有效率约70%–80%，复发或依赖者联用利妥昔单抗可获长期缓解；冷凝集素病（CAD）传统激素无效，但补体C1s单抗Sutimlimab已获批可迅速止血溶血；新型FcRn抑制剂Nipocalimab等正处于3期临床，为难治患者带来新希望。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO GHE未单列AIHA死因；现代免疫抑制与抗感染支持下急性期病死率约4%–10%，合并血栓栓塞或重度感染是主要死因

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国尚无全国单列死亡登记；国内多中心血液病队列显示继发于淋巴瘤、系统性红斑狼疮或合并Evans综合征者预后较原发者更差
annual_deaths_china.source: 中华医学会血液学分会《中国成人自身免疫性溶血性贫血诊疗指南》

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 欧美年发病率约 1–3 / 10万人年，时点患病率约 1–9 / 10万（Orphanet ORPHA:98375）
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 属血液科常见获得性溶血性贫血，中老年及自身免疫病女性人群高发

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 1) 患者突发极度乏力、呼吸困难、浓茶色尿、皮肤巩膜黄染或心慌晕厥，立即急诊查血常规、网织红细胞及直接抗人球蛋白试验（Coombs试验）; 2) 急诊第一时间静脉大剂量甲泼尼龙冲击（温抗体型）或严格保暖（冷凝集素病需加温输液输血）; 3) 注意输血难题：患者体内自身抗体会干扰交叉配血导致“配血不合”，危及生命的重度贫血缺氧（如Hb<40–50 g/L或合并冠心病休克）切勿因等待“完全相合”而延误抢救，应在严密监护下输注“最小不相合”洗涤红细胞并严防血栓栓塞。

standard_drugs.usage_role: 温抗体型AIHA一线基础急救与诱导缓解用药（冷凝集素病基本无效）
standard_drugs.cost_estimate_cny: 国内公立医院参考价约5–20元/盒，年药费约100–300元

standard_drugs.drug_class: 抗CD20单克隆抗体（靶向清除产生自身抗体的B淋巴细胞）
standard_drugs.usage_role: 温抗体型AIHA二线首选及冷凝集素病重要免疫清除方案
standard_drugs.cost_source: 中国公立医院药品挂网公开参考价

standard_drugs.usage_role: 冷凝集素病（CAD）获批靶向治疗
standard_drugs.cost_estimate_cny: 美国FDA/EMA已获批，国内尚待常规临床普及

non_drug_therapies_zh: 冷凝集素病患者严格防寒保暖（冬季戴手套耳罩、饮用温水、医院静脉输液与输血必须使用37℃加温器）
对激素与利妥昔单抗均无效的温抗体型AIHA患者评估腹腔镜脾切除术（注意预防血栓与感染）
全面排查潜在继发病因（如慢性淋巴细胞白血病、非霍奇金淋巴瘤、系统性红斑狼疮或支原体/EB病毒感染）

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 2023–2024年AIHA治疗全面迈向“去激素精准靶向”：1) 针对冷凝集素病，抗C1s单抗Sutimlimab长期扩展数据证实可持久维持血红蛋白正常并消除输血依赖; 2) 针对温抗体型AIHA，靶向新生儿Fc受体（FcRn）加速致病IgG降解的Nipocalimab（ENERGY 2/3期试验）、靶向SYK激酶的Fostamatinib以及BTK抑制剂（如Rilzabrutinib）均在临床试验中展现出快速止溶血且无需长期使用激素的潜力。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 约20%–30%温抗体型患者对激素和利妥昔单抗双重耐药（难治性wAIHA），国内尚缺乏获批的靶向新药（如FcRn抑制剂或SYK抑制剂）; 2) 冷凝集素病特效药Sutimlimab国内可及性极低; 3) 自身抗体干扰交叉配血常导致急诊抢救输血延误。

master.definition_en: A rare neoplasm arising from the ovary. Although it may occur at any age, it is more often seen in young females. Morphologically, it is characterized by a mixture of two cellular populations: well differentiated Sertoli cells and granulosa cells, with the latter constituting at least ten percent of the neoplasm. The vast majority of cases are stage I lesions at presentation and produce either estrogenic or androgenic manifestations. Although it may present as a massive ovarian tumor, it usually follows a benign clinical course. Very rare case reports of testicular lesions morphologically resembling gynandroblastomas are in fact variants of juvenile granulose cell tumor, or Sertoli cell tumor, or a combination of both.

master.definition_en: Livedoid vasculopathy is a blood vessel disorder that causes painful ulcers and scarring (atrophie blanche) on the feet and lower legs. These symptoms can persist for months to years and the ulcers often recur.Livedoid vasculopathy lesions appear as painful red or purple marks and spots that may progress to small, tender, irregular ulcers. Symptoms tend to worsen in the winter and summer months, and affect women more often then men. Livedoid vasculopathy may occur alone or in combination with another condition, such as lupus or thrombophilia.

master.definition_en: An autosomal recessive, multisystem condition caused by pathogenic variants of the PNPLA6 gene that characterized by peripheral neuropathy, cognitive impairment, lower limb spasticity, muscle weakness, and reduced vibration sense. master.definition_en: Any acute myeloid leukemia that has the chromosomal anomaly t(16;21)(q24;q22). It is associated with RUNX1/CBFA2T3 fusions, myelodysplastic syndromes and acute myeloid leukemia.)
